searchText: Toxic spam. Requesting a fast delete <@&754066708418920553> <@&595685821026271242> Thanks for flagging. Sometimes discord fails to delete all the messages when we ban a user - it's very annoying and means having to go through each individual channel manually deleting things. It's easy to miss some channels. Yeh, it's not great. A little easier is searching for messages of said user, and deleting them from there.
